title: Kamishiro Rui — A Sudden Trial〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, everyone! I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're late, Rui. Also, why are you the last to arrive? You were the one who asked us to gather.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize for that. I ended up having to carry more things than I initially realized.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys are gonna do something really fun today, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we are.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wonderful! What do you have in store for us? I'm looking forward to finding out♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Then, why don't we get started? For White Day...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! White Day?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, would you mind bringing them over?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Roger.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! What's with this mountain of things?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Can you guess?
I'll give you all some time to think while I get everything set up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I'll begin by putting all the parts together. Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Understood. Here is the portable stove, steel roller and the tools for putting everything together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A portable stove and steel roller?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait! Are you guys gonna do the thing where you light a bunch of big sticks on fire and twirl them around as you dance?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! No, I refuse to partake in that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
How did you arrive on that?
I mean, who prepares a fire dance for someone as a White Day gift?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That took me by surprise as well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were actually very close when you said that the roller would be set ablaze.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Miku☆
You were super close!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heehee♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You may figure it out once you see the rest of the ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Flour, sugar, eggs, milk and butter.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Isn't that everything you need to bake some sweets...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But what's that weird rod for?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it's all set.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow, you put your little device together so fast!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Rin, Len, thank you for helping make the batter.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I was sure he was going to use that roller on the batter, but he ended up attaching some sort of handle to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It even has a little arm on it that seems to allow it to move between the tray of batter and the stove...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... The batter and that rod... It gets roasted...? Wait, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, excellent. KAITO, I take it that you've figured it out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'll reveal the answer while getting to work on it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Robo-Nene, is the spit heated up?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, it is ready to use whenever.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, Nene, I'll need you to both help me for this next part.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
This is so exciting☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, you'll be in charge of moving the roller backwards and forwards. Nene, I'll need you to spin it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, Emu, starting with you!
Use the arm to move the roller just above the tray of batter for me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good! Now, lower it into the tray.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Next, Nene! Spin the roller in such a way that the batter spreads evenly across it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay... L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, they've added a thin layer of batter!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! What do you think they're making...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That should do it, Nene.
Emu, can you move the roller back above the flame...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, once it's hot, do I use the roller again to bake it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll repeat this process and bake it one layer at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At first glance, this probably appears similar to how a tree gains a ring for each year it lives. Now, what delicious dessert shares that same characteristic?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tree rings...? Ah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Baumkuchen!
Baumkuchen!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's correct!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, why don't we all take turns spinning it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've designed it so that anyone can use it safely, but please be mindful of the stove.

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Cool☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... Something smells delicious...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you're finally awake!
Luka, let's make our Baumkuchen together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Everyone's smiling.
Thank you for preparing such a fun White Day celebration for us, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. It's the least I could do considering how much you've all done for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, it's getting pretty big now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's take it off the spit and see how it tastes.
